items.headline: OpenAI to Add Invisible Watermarks to ChatGPT Text in the EU
items.summary: To comply with the EU AI Act, OpenAI will embed an invisible marker in text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for users in the European Union, rolling out over the coming weeks on all plans.
items.why_it_matters: If you or your clients publish ChatGPT-written copy to European audiences, that text may become detectable as AI-generated, so it's worth deciding how much you edit and disclose.

items.headline: ChatGPT Is Getting a New Visual Ad Format
items.summary: OpenAI announced a new image-style ad format inside ChatGPT plus better ad measurement tools, with testing starting later this month in the US with a small group of advertisers.
items.why_it_matters: ChatGPT could become another place small businesses buy ads, and it changes what free ChatGPT users will see.
